description: I am interested in space exploration, science, technology and innovation. I enjoy learning new things and developing creative solutions to real-world challenges. I am looking for passionate members who are interested in space science, research, technology and problem-solving. Let's learn, collaborate and create something meaningful together!
summary:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

I developed an interactive educational game called Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. It allows players to experience the responsibilities of an astronaut managing a space outpost on Mars or the Moon. Players must balance four important resources: power, food, radiation shielding, and life support.

The game includes interactive controls, environmental conditions, equipment maintenance, mission alerts, and decision-making challenges across five mission days (sols). Every decision affects the outpost's performance and survival.

This project addresses the challenge by helping students understand the difficulties of living and working in space through an engaging simulation. It combines science, technology, and problem-solving to make space exploration easier to understand. The project is important because it encourages young learners to think like astronauts and explore the science behind future space missions.
details: How the Project Works The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive browser-based simulation that allows players to manage a space outpost on Mars or the Moon. Players control four important resources: solar power, food, radiation shielding, and life support. They must balance these resources and complete a five-sol mission. The game includes equipment maintenance, environmental monitoring, weather forecasts, mission alerts, radio communications, and decision-making events. Players can monitor their progress through a flight log and receive a mission debrief and completion certificate. Benefits and Intended Impact The project helps students understand the challenges of space exploration through interactive learning. It develops problem-solving, decision-making, and resource-management skills while creating interest in astronomy and space science. Technology Used The project was developed as a web-based game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It runs in a web browser and does not require special hardware. Creativity The project combines astronaut training concepts with interactive gameplay. Players experience different mission situations and learn how decisions affect the stability of a space outpost. The resource values are simplified for educational purposes and are not real mission-planning data.
